description:
Get one stock's rows from graded books only, newest first: its forecast, rank, pick side and outcome in each
    book. Use this to follow one ticker across books, explain_resolved_prediction for the evidence behind one row, and
    get_resolved_batch for a whole book. An unknown ticker returns an empty list.

limit.description: Most rows to return, 1 to 500. Default 120.
limit.title: Limit

ticker.description: Stock ticker, for example AAPL. Upper or lower case both work.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: get_stock_resolved_history
title: One stock's history
